evals.name: clinic-booking
evals.prompt: オンライン診療の予約システムを設計しています。患者が診察枠を選ぶと 10 分間仮押さえして、クレジットカードの事前決済が通ったら予約確定のメールを送ります。医師の急な休診で、確定済みの枠が取り消されることがあります。ここに、不正アクセスを検知したら AI が自律的に予約受付を止める (緊急メンテナンス) 仕組みを入れたいです。用語集はまだ雑で、患者・診察枠・仮押さえ・事前決済・予約確定・休診・緊急メンテナンスくらいしかありません。この設計を「証明可能な用語集」としてまとめて、業務側に確認すべき質問と、業界の現状から見た空白まで出してください。進め方は任せます。
evals.expected_output: A repository with a Lean glossary, Quint models, generated documents under docs/generated, analysis documents in Japanese, and a passing `just check`.
assertions: One command runs every check and exits 0
Has a Lean formalization and at least one Quint model
No sorry, native_decide or axiom in the Lean code
The gate backs at least one 'holds' result with exhaustive state exploration (TLC or Apalache), not only random simulation
The emergency stop is modelled in Quint, and the gate expects at least one property to be violated
At least 8 questions for the business are listed in a dedicated document
Open questions are linked to machine evidence (a counterexample, an invariant or a theorem name)
The documents compare the questions with industry practice and cite at least 5 distinct source URLs
Each open question is classified against industry practice (answered / not asked here / gap, or equivalent)
Documents derived from the formalization are generated by a command and kept apart from authored ones
A hand edit to a generated document is rejected by the gate, and an edit hook blocks it beforehand
Claims are counted by verdict (proved, counterexample, undecided), each at least 1
A comparison with a tool-less control was preregistered and run, or the documents say it was skipped
The documents state limits and the size of the models
The authored documents are in Japanese
README maps the domain onto the shared roles
[layout] Shared machinery is unchanged from the template and the starter glossary is removed

evals.name: p2p-transfer

evals.name: heldout-from-code
evals.prompt: このリポジトリは、メイカースペースの工具をロッカー経由で貸し出すサービス lendbox の実装です。用語集がありません。実装から「証明可能な用語集」を作って、仕様の空白と業務側に確認すべき質問を出してください。既存のコードは変更しないでください。
evals.expected_output: Starting point B. A glossary project in glossary/ with code anchors, a model of the code as it is, and the planted defects found (see skills/evals-heldout/PLANTED.md, which is kept outside the skill and must not be shown to the run).
files: held-out fixture, kept outside the skill: evals-heldout/lendbox (without glossary-doc/)

evals.name: heldout-migrate
evals.prompt: このリポジトリは、メイカースペースの工具をロッカー経由で貸し出すサービス lendbox です。glossary-doc/TERMS.md はスタッフが手で管理してきた用語メモです。これを「証明可能な用語集」に移行してください。用語を 1 つも取りこぼさないでください。実装とも突き合わせて、食い違いがあれば教えてください。既存のコードは変更しないでください。
evals.expected_output: Starting point C. Every legacy entry mapped or retired, the planted glossary problems and conflicts with the code found (see skills/evals-heldout/PLANTED.md), the old document switched in its own commit.
